{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:12.319
    | text      = When an actor says that they got Taft Hartley, that doesn't mean that they got made part
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:16.000
    | text      = of the Screen Actors Guild.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:18.000
    | text      = If a production that's in compliance with the union wants to hire a non-union actor
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:21.760
    | text      = for a role that they believe no qualified or available union member can fill, then they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:26.380
    | text      = have to fill out a Taft Hartley form.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:28.960
    | text      = This allows them to hire a non-union actor and allows the actor a free pass to join SAG
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:34.079
    | text      = for 30 days.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:36.000
    | text      = This is one of the ways that an actor can get into SAG and make themselves available
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:40.600
    | text      = for SAG productions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:42.300
    | text      = The other main ways are they're dependent on getting booked for a major role or paying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:47.659
    | text      = dues for a year, which most people can't do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:51.600
    | text      = You'll often hear stories of struggling actors getting a job and getting Taft Hartley, which
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:55.840
    | text      = is kind of a blessing and a curse.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:32:58.279
    | text      = It means that you're working, but it also means that you probably need to join SAG and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:33:02.159
    | text      = start paying dues, which can be a huge burden on you if you don't end up getting more work.
}}
